zh.title: 立院通過無人機預算 貿協將助業者拓展海外
zh.summary: 台灣通過百億無人載具預算；外貿協會將協助業者布局國際市場
body: 台灣立法院於2026年8月14日三讀通過為期6年、總額新台幣442億元的「無人載具產業發展統籌型計畫」預算案。外貿協會董事長黃志芳於8月15日表示，該預算案的通過為台灣無人機產業注入強心針，外貿協會將全力協助業者拓展海外市場。
黃志芳指出，台灣在資通訊、晶片設計、電子控制及馬達、電池等關鍵零組件具有優勢，相對欠缺的是國內需求。外貿協會將運用多元平台協助產業與國際接軌，明年台北「國際航太暨國防工業展」將設置無人機主題館，今年10月也將舉辦國防產業論壇，邀請全球專家與國內業者交流。

en.title: Taiwan Passes NT$44.2 Billion Budget for Unmanned Vehicle Industry
en.summary: TAITRA will assist Taiwan's drone industry in expanding globally after a budget approval on August 14.
body: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan passed a six-year, NT$44.2 billion budget for the "Unmanned Vehicle Industry Development Coordination Program" on August 14, 2026. In response, Taiwan External Trade Development Council (TAITRA) Chairman Huang Chih-fang stated on August 15 that the approved budget provides a significant boost, and TAITRA will actively assist domestic drone operators in expanding into global markets.

According to Huang, Taiwan possesses strong foundations in components like ICT, chip design, electronic controls, motors, and batteries. To facilitate overseas promotion, next year's Taipei Aerospace & Defense Technology Exhibition will feature a drone pavilion, and a defense industry forum focusing on drones will be held this October to promote international exchange.
